title: 第13章 无灵根的少女第14章 以凡体之身位居仙道之巅
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
“牛掰，我眼花了吗？灵霄宗弟子都敢打？”
“有热闹看了，你们猜这天道宗多久就会被灵霄宗报复灭了？”
“我看最多三天，如果不是云水城的几位灵霄宗执事有什么事全出去了，恐怕现在就来了！”
“三天？能坚持一天算天道宗厉害！”
........
广场内，议论纷纷，许多人都摇了摇头，似乎已经预见了天道宗的悲惨境遇。
几百年来，不是没有宗门挑衅过灵霄宗的地位，但结局都只有一个。
那就是统统覆灭，化作历史的尘埃！
仙盟五百强的超级势力，又岂是寻常宗门可以仰望的？
整个大赵帝国，有资格与灵霄宗正面对话的，只有同为仙盟五百强的云天宗一个！
其余的，连帝国皇室都没有这个资格！
“师尊，抱歉，我这么一闹，更加无人敢加入宗门了。”
诸葛风有些愧疚的低下了头，此刻广场中的众人，都不敢靠近天道宗的招牌，生怕被灵霄宗的报复所波及。
今天招收弟子，怕是要空手而归了。
苏白淡淡一笑：“这是好消息，你已经把我天道宗的名声打出来了。”
“不仅没有坏处，反而有利无弊。”
“等灵霄宗奈何不了我天道宗的时候，所有人的目光，都会看向我天道宗，到时候，自有人排队想入我天道宗。”
“不过，你刚刚做的还不够好。”
“啊？”诸葛风一怔，不明白自家师尊说的意思。
自己出手已经这么重了，师尊还觉得不够好？

“对于这种人，你就应该往死里打。”
“你要记住，拳头硬才是道理。”
“你越懦弱，别人才越会欺压你，你越是强硬，别人只会敬畏你！”
“你若是表现的懦弱胆怯，别人反而会骑在你脖子上拉屎撒尿，不将你当人看！”
“记住，这世界就是这样，永远都是强者为王。”
苏白淡漠道。
“我...弟子懂了。”诸葛风眼神坚定了不少，似乎明悟了什么。
“不用管对方是谁，只要不是你的错，一切有为师在。”苏白继续道。
闻言，诸葛风心中激荡。
如果自己有师尊这样的实力就好了！
想到这，他握紧了拳头！
他不喜欢平庸的日子！他渴望战斗，渴望提升实力，成为顶尖高手，再也无人可以欺负他！
“帅！”
萧灵汐兴奋的拍手鼓掌，两只眸子亮晶晶的盯着苏白。
她也想起了之前苏白出手斩杀灵霄宗的执事。
果断！
迅速！
丝毫不含糊！
简单粗暴，干净利索。
而且，还帅气！

...........
百宗会入口，出现了一位奇怪的少女。
content_en:
"That's awesome, am I dazzled? Do you dare to attack Lingxiao Sect disciples?"
"Looking at the excitement, how long do you think it will take for Tiandao Sect to be wiped out by Lingxiao Sect?"
"I think it will take three days at most. If it weren't for the fact that several Lingxiao Sect deacons in Yunshui City had to go out because of something, I'm afraid they would be here now!"
"Three days? If you can last for one day, Tiandao Sect is considered powerful!"
........
There was a lot of discussion in the square, and many people shook their heads, as if they had foreseen the tragic situation of Tiandao Sect.
Over the past hundreds of years, not all sects have challenged Lingxiao Sect's status, but there was only one ending.
That means everything will be destroyed and turned into the dust of history!
How can the 500-strong super power of the Immortal Alliance be something that ordinary sects can look up to?
In the entire Zhao Empire, the only one who is qualified to have a direct dialogue with the Lingxiao Sect is the Yuntian Sect, who is also one of the top 500 Immortal Alliance!
The rest, even the imperial royal family do not have this qualification!
"Master, I'm sorry. If I make such a fuss, no one will dare to join the sect."
Zhuge Feng lowered his head with some guilt. At this moment, no one in the square dared to get close to the Tiandao Sect's sign for fear of being affected by Lingxiao Sect's revenge.
I am recruiting disciples today, but I am afraid I will come back empty-handed.
Su Bai smiled faintly: "This is good news. You have already made my Tiandao Sect's reputation famous."
“Not only does it have no disadvantages, it actually has both advantages and disadvantages.”
"When Lingxiao Sect can't do anything to our Tiandao Sect, everyone's eyes will be on our Tiandao Sect. By then, there will be people lining up to join our Tiandao Sect."
"However, what you just did was not good enough."
"Ah?" Zhuge Feng was startled, not understanding what his master meant.
He has already struck such a heavy blow, Master still thinks it is not good enough?
"For this kind of person, you should beat him to death."
"You have to remember that hard fists are the only way to go."
"The cowardly you are, the more others will bully you; the tougher you are, the more others will fear you!"
"If you act cowardly, others will poop and pee on your neck instead of treating you as a human being!"
"Remember, this is the way this world is, and the strong will always be king."
Su Bai said indifferently.
"I...disciple understands." Zhuge Feng's eyes became firmer, as if he had understood something.
"It doesn't matter who the other party is, as long as it's not your fault, everything will be done with a teacher." Su Bai continued.
Hearing this, Zhuge Feng's heart agitated.
It would be great if I had the strength of Master!
Thinking of this, he clenched his fists!
He doesn't like mediocre days! He is eager to fight, eager to improve his strength and become a top master. No one can bully him anymore!
"Handsome!"
Xiao Lingxi clapped her hands excitedly and stared at Su Bai with her bright eyes.
She also remembered that Su Bai had killed the deacon of Lingxiao Sect before.
decisive!
fast!
No ambiguity at all!
Simple, crude, and neat.
Moreover, he is handsome!
...........
At the entrance of the Hundred Sects Association, a strange girl appeared.
